meta.featureName: Move the heat bar out of the gear menu

state.contextHint: Layout/CSS move only: keep [(ngModel)]="this.distance"; don't touch the win check or distance scale (#28). Run builds/tests pinned to 2 cores (taskset -c 0,1, NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=2). Measuring with headless Chrome under software WebGL: open the gear with element.click() via evaluate and wait ~2.5 s; the /game route shows the welcome pop-up on load. Share specs must stub navigator.clipboard and window.alert/prompt (native dialogs hang headless Chrome).

waves.name: Foundational: the heat bar leaves the gear menu
waves.description: #result-container becomes a sibling of the menu, fixed bottom-center

waves.name: US1/US2: visible and updating, menu open or closed, both views
waves.description: No menuVisible coupling; same update event

waves.name: US4 + cleanup
waves.description: New help line, aria-label, dead CSS/TS removed

waves.name: Polish: tests and verification

T001.description: Move #result-container out of <form #parameters-menu> to a top-level sibling in src/app/game/game.component.html, and give it a base fixed bottom-center position in game.component.css that doesn't depend on the menu.

T002.description: Keep the bar visible with the gear menu closed and in place while it's open (no menuVisible coupling); confirm it updates on a parameter slider change and shows in the Objetivo view.

T003.description: Responsive layout in game.component.css: one row between the switch and the #11 buttons on wide screens, its own row above the buttons at 800 px and below (measured; planned ~760 px). No overlap or clipping at 390/768/1280 px, clear of the top-right #13 corner, .modal stays above. Record the breakpoint and bar width on #15.

T004.description: Replace AppStrings.LABEL_HOWTO_WINDOW_LINE3 in src/app/app-strings.ts with the approved text; add aria-label="Qué tan cerca estás del objetivo" to #distance-range.

T005.description: Delete the unused .heat-range.blue / .heat-range.read thumb styles (game.component.css) and the unused distanceRange getter and its @ViewChild (game.component.ts).

T006.description: Tests in src/app/game/game.component.spec.ts: rewrite the #11 spec that expected the bar inside the menu; add specs for the bar outside the menu, visible with the menu closed and open, value updating on a slider change, LINE3 text and aria-label. Run ng build and ng test on 2 cores; take before/after screenshots at 390/768/1280 px (menu open and closed) for approval on #15.
